sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen-Agent: Agent framework and applications built upon ...
sources.snippet: Qwen-Agent is a framework for developing LLM applications based on the instruction following, tool usage, planning, and memory capabilities of Qwen. It also comes with example applications such as Browser Assistant, Code Interpreter, and Custom Assistant. Now Qwen-Agent plays as the backend of Qwen Chat.
